title: China-to-Montenegro Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: PV inverter EMC evidence in Montenegro should be prepared around IEC 61000-family test methods and IEC 62920 for inverter EMC. ISME is the national standards body, while REGAGEN and CGES may expect EMC evidence as part of interconnection documentation.
target_standards: IEC 62920 — Photovoltaic power generating systems EMC requirements and test methods
IEC 61000 series — electromagnetic compatibility test methods and limits
REGAGEN and CGES documentation requirements for PV interconnection
rows.china_equivalent: China PV inverter EMC evidence is commonly based on GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, and reports from CNAS-accredited laboratories under Chinese domestic requirements. Those reports help technical comparison but are not substitutes for IEC 62920 or project-specific IEC 61000 evidence unless model scope, limits, accreditation, and report language are accepted by Montenegro reviewers.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求
NB/T 32004 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范
rows.gap: Exporters should map China GB/T or NB/T EMC evidence clause-by-clause to IEC 62920 and the relevant IEC 61000 tests before submission. Prepare model-specific internationally aligned EMC reports and document differences from Chinese test conditions versus Montenegro 230/400 V and 50 Hz applications.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where required by ISME, REGAGEN, CGES project review, or project-owner interconnection documentation
mandatory_status.cn: China GB/T/NB/T EMC evidence may support project comparison but is not automatically recognised for Montenegro review

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not rely on Chinese GB/T 37408-2021 or NB/T 32004 EMC evidence alone for Montenegro. Prepare IEC 62920 and IEC 61000 coverage evidence for each inverter model and confirm acceptance.

rows.requirement: REGAGEN SSEG / Net-Metering and CGES Grid-Connection Review
rows.target_requirement: Grid-tied PV inverter projects in Montenegro should meet three local gates: ISME conformity expectations for standards, REGAGEN licensing or approval for small-scale embedded generation and net-metering, and CGES connection review before energisation. Montenegro uses a 230/400 V, 50 Hz nominal low-voltage system, so model-level validation against protection settings, anti-islanding logic, and utility commissioning requirements is required.
target_standards: REGAGEN small-scale embedded generation and net-metering framework
IEC 62116 — islanding prevention measures for utility-interconnected inverters
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese grid-connection evidence commonly includes GB/T 19964-2024, NB/T 32004, and domestic anti-islanding or utility-interface reports. These documents do not automatically satisfy REGAGEN licensing, CGES connection review, or Montenegro site commissioning requirements.
china_standards: GB/T 19964-2024 — 光伏发电站接入技术规定
NB/T 32004 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范
GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求
rows.gap: Chinese GB/T or NB/T documents should be treated as supporting evidence only. Exporters should prepare IEC 62116 and IEC 61727 evidence, anti-islanding and reconnection settings for a 230/400 V, 50 Hz deployment, and confirm any local Montenegrin grid-code requirements before project energisation.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for grid-tied projects: REGAGEN and CGES review remains project gates before energisation
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese grid-connection evidence does not transfer automatically to Montenegro approval

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Confirm REGAGEN and CGES project gates separately from Chinese baseline documentation. Prepare Montenegro-specific interconnection settings and acceptance files for each model and site.

rows.requirement: IEC 62109-1 / IEC 62109-2 Safety Evidence for PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: For Montenegro PV inverter projects, safety evidence should be prepared around IEC 62109-1 and IEC 62109-2 for photovoltaic power converters. ISME is the standards body, while REGAGEN and CGES review may require proof that the inverter model is safe for the planned grid-tied installation, including anti-islanding and utility interface behavior.
target_standards: IEC 62109-1 — Safety of power converters for photovoltaic systems
REGAGEN and CGES interconnection and installation review
rows.china_equivalent: China commonly relies on GB/T 37408-2021 and NB/T 32004 plus domestic type-test reports for PV inverters. These are useful for technical comparison but are not direct substitutes for Montenegro EN/IEC evidence or project acceptance.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求
NB/T 32004 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范
rows.gap: Chinese GB/T/NB/T reports should be supplemented with IEC 62109-1/-2 certificates or reports for exact inverter models. Exporters should verify any requirement for international lab recognition, English documentation, factory inspection records, and model-family coverage before shipping.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where ISME, REGAGEN, or CGES interconnection review requires model-level safety evidence for grid-facing equipment
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese safety evidence supports comparison but does not directly satisfy Montenegro interconnection evidence

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Build Montenegro PV inverter filing packages on IEC 62109 evidence and ensure model-level mapping from China documents to EN/IEC safety requirements.
